verdict.rationale: Evidence only vaguely references a 'Decision Center' where 'policies' can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, implying some rule-based decisioning exists, but there is no documentation of authoring custom rules that combine model scores, velocity counters, list matches, and transaction attributes into allow/block/review outcomes. Missing for 10: rule-builder UI/API documentation, velocity counter configuration, list-matching logic, and explicit allow/block/review outcome mapping.
